boundary: These names describe exact S6 orbit and incidence structures; no physical interpretation is attached.

designs.pair180: Each pair coordinate occurs four times.
designs.pair_phase180: Each pair coordinate occurs twice and each phase coordinate nine times.
designs.size120: Each residual coordinate occurs six times and each pair coordinate twice.
designs.size15: The 15 residual-only words are the boundaries of the 15 tetrahedra on four-subsets of six; every one of the 20 residual triads occurs three times.
designs.size45: The 45 pair-only tetrads partition the 180 pair coordinates exactly once.

theorem: The 540 minimum words are exactly the 540 frame matchings. Under exceptional S6 they split into five orbits of sizes 15,45,120,180,180; the nominal 225 pair-only split type is two geometrically distinct orbits of sizes 45 and 180.
